features.title: Domma.component() — Web Components API
features.description: New first-class Web Components system allowing developers to define reusable, encapsulated UI components with a clean declarative API
features.details:
Domma.component(name, definition) registers a native Web Component (Custom Element) with Shadow DOM encapsulation. The definition object mirrors the familiar Domma conventions:

  • data() — Returns the component's initial reactive state object
  • computed — Object of functions that derive values from this.data, recalculated on every update
  • methods — Event handler and utility functions, all bound to the component instance
  • props — Type-validated, default-valued attributes observed from HTML (M.types.* type system)
  • style — CSS string injected into the Shadow DOM; fully encapsulated, cannot leak or be overridden from outside
  • templateUrl — Path to an external .html file for the component's markup; loaded and cached on first mount
  • onBeforeMount() — Called before the template is inserted; use for data pre-fetching
  • onMount($container) — Called after template is in the Shadow DOM; wire event listeners here
  • onUpdated(changedData) — Called after any this.set() call; perform targeted DOM refreshes
  • onUnmount() — Called before the element is removed; clean up timers and listeners

CSS variable passthrough: All --dm-* CSS variables flow from the host page into the Shadow DOM, so components theme-adapt automatically.

features.title: Template Compiler with Mustache Bindings
features.description: New template compiler supporting {{variable}}, {{#if}}, {{#each}}, and {{#unless}} within component templates
features.details:
The template compiler processes component HTML templates before insertion into the Shadow DOM:

  • {{variable}} — Interpolates data and computed values (HTML-escaped by default)
  • {{{variable}}} — Unescaped HTML interpolation (use with caution)
  • {{#if condition}}...{{/if}} — Conditional blocks
  • {{#unless condition}}...{{/unless}} — Inverted conditional blocks
  • {{#each items}}...{{/each}} — Iteration with {{this}} and {{@index}}

Static template pattern: Components with user-editable inputs use zero-binding templates and drive all updates through targeted onUpdated() methods, preventing full re-renders from destroying focused elements.

features.title: Four Example DommaComponents
features.description: Calculator, To-Do List, Markdown Editor, and Notes App converted to self-contained <domma-*> Web Components
features.details:
Each example app was converted from a standalone page script into a downloadable <domma-*> component:

  • <domma-calculator> — Basic and scientific modes, memory (M+/M−/MR/MC), angle toggle (DEG/RAD), full keyboard support, initialMode prop
  • <domma-todo> — Add/edit/delete tasks, priority (Low/Medium/High/Critical), status (To-Do/In Progress/Done/Cancelled), search filter, localStorage persistence via storageKey prop
  • <domma-markdown-editor> — Split-pane live preview, toolbar shortcuts, debounced auto-save, Ctrl+B/Ctrl+I/Ctrl+K keyboard shortcuts, word and character count, configurable autoSaveDelay prop
  • <domma-notes> — Notes grid, overlay editor, rich-text toolbar, category tagging, full-text search, last-saved relative timestamp via D().fromNow()

All four components: use S.get()/S.set() for persistence, E.toast()/E.confirm()/E.prompt() for dialogs (light-DOM, works from Shadow DOM), I.scan() for icon rendering, and _.render() + _.escape() for safe HTML generation. Drop in with a single tag — no configuration required.

features.title: DommaComponents Showcase
features.description: New dedicated showcase page covering the full component API with live demos, code examples, and a comprehensive tutorial
features.details:
The Components showcase at /showcase/components/ covers:

  • Live interactive demo of a custom <domma-card> component
  • Full API reference: data, computed, methods, props, style, templateUrl, lifecycle
  • Shadow DOM encapsulation explained with visual examples
  • CSS variable passthrough and theming patterns
  • Static template pattern for form-heavy components
  • Event delegation pattern for dynamic lists
  • Comparison with vanilla Custom Elements showing the DX improvement

features.title: Splash Page — Examples Row
features.description: Eight example tiles added to the landing page above MiniApps, with Scribe typewriter descriptions on hover
features.details:
The landing page now surfaces all eight example applications in a tile row above the MiniApps section:

  • To-Do List, Calculator, Markdown Editor, Notes, Contacts, Gallery, Weather, Celebrations
  • Hovering a tile fires a second Domma.effects.scribe() instance in a dedicated description container beneath the row
  • The two scribe instances (splash tagline and example description) operate independently with no state conflicts
  • Both instances clean up correctly when animations are disabled via the motion toggle
  • Tiles animate in with the same stagger effect as the feature cards

Also standardised the View All Examples → and View All MiniApps → buttons to identical btn btn-outline btn-sm styling, and increased vertical spacing between the two sections.

enhancements.title: Component Plugin System
enhancements.description: Extensible plugin architecture for registering component behaviours and mixins
enhancements.details: A lightweight plugin system allows framework-level behaviours to be registered and shared across components without modifying the core factory. Plugins receive the component instance at mount time and can add methods, watchers, or lifecycle extensions.

enhancements.title: DommaElement Base Class
enhancements.description: Shared HTMLElement base class providing common utilities to all Domma web components
enhancements.details:
All registered Domma components extend DommaElement, which provides:

  • Shadow root initialisation with mode: 'open'
  • Safe this.set(key, value) method that merges state and triggers onUpdated()
  • Attribute observation wired to prop definitions
  • Automatic cleanup of event listeners on disconnect

enhancements.title: Rollup Plugin for Component Bundling
enhancements.description: Rollup configuration updated to handle component files and external HTML templates
enhancements.details: The build pipeline now handles component .js files and can inline or reference companion template.html files during bundling, enabling production-ready component distribution.

bugFixes.title: Fixed E.prompt(), E.confirm(), E.alert() Silent Failures
bugFixes.description: Corrected British/American spelling mismatch in the internal sanitization module that caused dialog methods and tooltip HTML rendering to silently fail
bugFixes.details:
Root cause: sanitize.js exports its function as sanitise (British spelling), but elements.js was calling sanitizeModule.sanitize() (American spelling). This resolved to undefined, throwing TypeError: r.sanitize is not a function silently inside promise chains.

Affected: E.prompt(), E.confirm(), E.alert(), tooltips with HTML content, toast messages containing HTML, and the slideover component.

Fix: Replaced all 12 occurrences of sanitizeModule.sanitize with sanitizeModule.sanitise in elements.js. Rebuilt bundles.

Discovery: Found while testing the <domma-todo> edit function, which calls E.prompt() to pre-fill the task text for editing.
